summary: Iteration 31 — backend + frontend testing for real-estate funnel, mega-menu click-to-reveal, post-purchase team-invite SaaS flow, niche-aware exit modal, warm-lead capture, and money-back-guarantee removal. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (warm-leads with dedupe; PayPal create_order for realestate_starter/premium/enterprise at correct amounts incl. $500 full-upfront discount and 50/50 split; full company-setup wizard + invite accept + role mgmt incl. owner-protection + non-admin 403). Frontend: All 4 RE pages render with every required data-testid (re-hero/prequal/problem/solution/offer + 3 tier cards + 3 pay buttons + roi/social-proof/faq/final-cta; re-how-{layers,integrations,journey,security}; re-process timeline+commitment+support+risk+checklist+upgrade; re-results cases+numbers+roadmap+roi+next+faq). RE shared NAV (re-nav-overview/how-it-works/our-process/results) navigates correctly. Mega menu: default placeholder (no playbook visible), clicking mega-industry-gym-owners/coaches/real-estate reveals the corresponding mega-playbook plus all mega-link-* children. Mobile drawer exposes For Real Estate Agents link. /portal/welcome unauth → /login?next=/portal/welcome ✓. /join/invalid-token shows invite-error ✓. RECheckoutDialog opens with Starter $2,995 (no split toggle, skipSplit honored), and POST /api/leads/warm fires on email blur (network captured). 30-day money-back string absent from /gym-owners, /coaches, /real-estate, /pricing.

integration_issues.issue: Step 1 renders correctly (welcome-step-1, welcome-company-name/phone/address all present). Clicking welcome-step-1-next (Continue) and waiting up to 2.5s did NOT advance to welcome-step-2 in headless run (step 2 testids never appeared, follow-up welcome-invite-add-row click timed out). Could be slow saveProfile API call, missing await, or button needing two clicks. Step-2 logic is fine via API (test_iteration_31.py covers it), but the FE transition could not be verified end-to-end in headless mode.

action_items: Investigate CompanyWelcomeWizard step1→step2 transition: confirm welcome-step-1-next button awaits POST /api/company-setup/profile before setStep(2), and that no error is silently swallowed. Main agent can self-verify by hand-walking the wizard at /portal/welcome (login → fill 3 fields → click Continue → should land on Team step within ~1s).
critical_code_review_comments: company_setup_routes.py — /company-setup/invites auto-promotes setup_status to 'complete' when name+phone are set on the company. This is convenient but the wizard also has a /company-setup/complete endpoint. Consider making the auto-complete explicit (move logic out of /invites) so 'send 0 invites + skip' on the wizard also clearly transitions to complete.

company_setup_routes.py — /companies/me/members/{member_id}/role permits demoting owner ONLY if role stays 'admin'. Defensive but odd. Recommend explicitly rejecting any role change on is_owner=true rather than relying on payload.role check.
warm_leads_routes.py — GET /leads/warm is unauthenticated (only protected by admin UI route). Should be wrapped with admin auth guard before production traffic.
RECheckoutDialog — onBlur warm-lead capture fires once. Consider debouncing if user re-blurs (already deduped on backend, so non-blocking).

CompanyWelcomeWizard — step1-next button should show a spinner/disable while saveProfile is in flight; current 'Continue' button likely returns without visible loading state during the API roundtrip (could explain my failed FE transition test).

Header.jsx mega-panel uses onMouseLeave→scheduleClose; click-to-reveal works but it's still a hover-mounted panel. A mobile/touch user can't open the desktop mega menu without the mobile drawer fallback (which IS provided). Acceptable today.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 wizard transition not end-to-end verified in headless)

test_credentials: Used dynamically-generated TEST_ clients via POST /api/clients/register (email '@example.com', password 'TestPass1234!').
seed_data_creation: TEST_ owner + invitee + outsider clients, TEST_warm_* warm-leads, and 4 sandbox PayPal orders (realestate_starter x2, premium, enterprise) were created and persist in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 is GREEN on backend (24/24) and largely green on frontend. Only open item: confirm /portal/welcome step1→step2 transition in the real browser. Test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md still valid. Backend test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_31.py and is rerunnable as a regression suite for warm leads, RE PayPal tiers, and company-setup flow.
rca of the issue: n/a — only one observed flake (FE wizard transition) — likely UX timing (button does not disable + saveProfile not awaited visibly), not a functional bug. Backend /company-setup/profile works fine (proven by pytest).
